verdict.rationale: Klaviyo documents in-product AI. Composer builds audiences, drafts content and maps send strategy for user review, the pricing page lists 'Get answers from your data', and there is an AI subject line generator, so AI suggestions inside the product are evidenced. The data-insights side rests on a single terse pricing-page fragment, and the MCP server is an external-client capability that does not count as inside the product. Missing for 10: documentation of in-app AI insights or analytics answers (what they cover, how they surface), how suggestions draw on account data, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Tell Composer what you're trying to achieve, and it'll build the audience, draft the content, and map out the send strategy.
Composer can make supported changes, build marketing for your review
